findings.problem: The Spanish card contactar-contact (to contact) means the same as getting in touch with someone, so a picture of it shows this card's meaning.

back.target: to get in touch, to be in touch (call, write or reply to someone)
back.example: Get in touch when you've arrived!

note: Because of the word "back", the hint "call or write back" could make a learner think of sich zurückmelden or zurückrufen; "call or write to someone" would avoid that, but sich melden covers getting back to someone too, so the hint is still right.
